description: Source code for SMP transport layer in Zephyr RTOS, handling SMP packet processing, queue management, and transport initialization.

methods.name: smp_packet_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a network buffer from the packet pool.

methods.name: smp_packet_free
methods.description: Releases a network buffer back to the pool.

methods.name: smp_alloc_rsp
methods.description: Allocates and prepares a response buffer, optionally copying user data from a request buffer.

methods.name: smp_free_buf
methods.description: Frees a buffer, calling user-defined free function if available.

methods.name: smp_process_packet
methods.description: Processes a single SMP packet and sends responses.

methods.name: smp_handle_reqs
methods.description: Handles incoming SMP requests from the queue.

methods.name: smp_client_transport_get
methods.description: Retrieves a registered SMP client transport by type.

methods.name: smp_client_transport_register
methods.description: Registers a new SMP client transport.

methods.name: smp_rx_req
methods.description: Enqueues an incoming SMP request for processing.

methods.name: smp_tx_req
methods.description: Submits a transmit request to the work queue.

methods.name: smp_rx_remove_invalid
methods.description: Removes invalid SMP request buffers based on a validation check.

methods.name: smp_rx_clear
methods.description: Clears all pending SMP request buffers.
